tool.name: Bismark Deduplicate

param.name: mapping_output
param.label: Submit the resulting bam/sam file from Bismark bisulfite mapper

param.name: separate_logfile
param.label: Create a separate logfile, otherwise logs are added to the dataset info.

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool removes alignments to the same position in the genome from the Bismark mapping output (both single and paired-end SAM/BAM files), which can arise by e.g. excessive PCR amplification. If sequences align to the same genomic position but on different strands they will be scored individually.
Note that deduplication is not recommended for RRBS-type experiments.
For single-end alignments only the start-coordinate of a read will be used for deduplication. For paired-end alignments the start-coordinate of the first read and the end coordinate of the second read will be used for deduplication.
